label: Zabady
note: Egyptian zabady: the milk is boiled hard first; the heat treatment is long (85 °C to boiling, 10 to 30 minutes), which thickens the milk before it is set

about.text: The yoghurt of Egypt, made mainly from buffalo or cow milk and firm enough to hold its shape. Sold commercially and made at home, where a spoonful of the last batch starts the next.
